issues: No integrity problems. The diff only halves learning_rate (0.03 to 0.015) and doubles n_estimators in both stages (200 to 400, 400 to 800). Training uses only train_smiles and y. It does not read files, paste in answers or use test labels.

No bugs found. Stage 2 still warm-starts from the stage-1 booster, and the base offset is handled as before. The step sizes times the tree counts are the same as before, so the fit should land in about the same place. That fits with a result that differs only by noise.
Training time will roughly double because there are twice as many trees. With 800+400 trees on 728 molecules this should still finish well inside the 10-minute limit.

My z is about -0.331. I used sd 0.0037 and divided by sqrt(1/1 + 1/2) for 1 candidate run against 2 incumbent runs: (0.3655 - 0.367) / (0.0037 * 1.2247). That matches the reported -0.333 after rounding. The candidate is 0.0015 worse, which is well within noise, so rejecting it is correct.
